report:
Left fallopian tube, salpingectomy

Received in formalin is a left fallopian tube measuring 5 cm in length and 0.6 cm in diameter. A thin-walled paratubal cyst measuring 2 cm is attached. All embedded in 3 blocks.

(1) Fimbria. (2) Cross sections of the fallopian tube. (3) Paratubal cyst.

Sections show fimbrial tissue and cross sections of the left fallopian tube with unremarkable plicae. A paratubal cyst is seen, with a fibrous wall lined by ciliated tubal-type epithelium. There is no evidence of malignancy.

Left FALLOPIAN TUBE, salpingectomy - PARATUBAL CYST
